name: Lofi Cities
use_label: Pixel-art city nights with lofi music
one_liner: Pixel-art city nights with lofi music generated in your browser — a backdrop for working.

text.why: Sometimes you want a quiet backdrop while working or studying. Lofi Cities shows scenes like a rainy Paris attic, with the city's local time and weather.
text.take: No install — one tab you leave on while you work.
build: Pick a city and the pixel-art scene and local time change, with weather and tour (city rotation) options. The music is generated in the browser, and it shows how many people are watching now.

who.role: Anyone who keeps calm music and visuals on while working or studying.

caveat: The site carries a paid job-ads strip along the top (cropped from our image). Source availability and licence could not be confirmed.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

images.alt: Lofi Cities' Paris scene: a pixel-art attic with the Eiffel Tower through a rainy window, playback controls below.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
null in the JSON means not observed — never zero. The Markdown writes [unconfirmed] for it.
